## Description

Creates `generated/` if it is missing, and writes `generated/README.txt` saying the directory holds automatically generated files. It then lists the working directory recursively (`ls -lR`), so the pipeline log shows what was downloaded.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/00_prepare_aux.sh
```

No arguments. [51_split-parts.sh](#help-51_split-parts) also sources it at the end.
